easy.q: How many points wins a standard game of ping-pong?
How many points is the letter Q worth in Scrabble?
easy.fact: Z is the only other letter worth 10.

easy.q: How many guesses do you get in Wordle?
easy.fact: The New York Times bought the game in 2022.

easy.q: How many U.S. states have a Kansas City?
easy.fact: Kansas City, Missouri, is the bigger one.

easy.q: How many Wonders of the Ancient World were there?
easy.fact: Only the Great Pyramid of Giza is still standing.

medium.q: How many U.S. presidents have won the Nobel Peace Prize?
medium.fact: Theodore Roosevelt, Woodrow Wilson, Jimmy Carter and Barack Obama.

medium.q: How many Oscars has Meryl Streep won?
medium.fact: She holds the record for acting nominations, with 21.

medium.q: How many double stitches are on an official MLB baseball?
medium.fact: They're sewn by hand, mostly in Costa Rica.

medium.q: How many U.S. states have two-word names?
medium.fact: Four start with New, two with North, two with South, plus Rhode Island and West Virginia.

medium.q: How many major championships did Arnold Palmer win?

hard.q: How old was Alexander the Great when he died?
hard.fact: His empire stretched from Greece to India.

hard.q: In 2020, Schitt's Creek set a record for a comedy's single season. How many Emmys did it win?
hard.fact: It swept all seven major comedy categories.

hard.q: How many inches is it from the pitcher's rubber to home plate?
How many miles long is Lake Superior?
hard.fact: It holds about 10% of the world's fresh surface water.
